senses.gloss:
ङ The fifth consonant of the Sanskrit alphabet, and the nasal of the
first class; the sound of this letter corresponds with that of the
nasal N in Song, &c. or in the French word bon.

ङ m. (-ङः)
 1. An object of sense.
 2. Desire, wish for any sensual object.
E. ङु to sound, affix. ड । विषये विषयस्पृ हायां भैरवे च ।
